content.text: Index 23 (MgSb2O6 region) and index 8 both gave near-zero EQE. Next I'm running XRD at other points on the line to look for a phase that absorbs at 2.1 eV.
All EQE measurements are used up. Submitting index 26 as the best measured composition.

input.rationale: At 2.1 eV illumination, which is below the gap of the stable Mg-Sb oxides (MgSb2O6 ~2.8 eV by MEGNet, higher experimentally; Mg4Sb2O9 ~4.2 eV), every measured EQE is near zero. Index 26 (Sb 0.757) gave the highest value, 3.3e-4 %. Its XRD is also the only one with film peaks that are not from the Pt substrate (Q 1.91, 2.45, 3.65), so crystalline Sb-rich material forms there. Index 25 read -5.2e-4 %, so the noise is about the same size as all the signals and the ranking has little meaning.

content.text:
I submitted index 26 (Sb fraction 0.757) as the best composition. Its reading is only slightly higher than the others, so it's a weak pick: nothing on this line showed a real photoresponse under 2.1 eV light.

**EQE results (all 5 measurements used):**

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.125 | 0.00002 |
| 8 | 0.260 | 0.00008 |
| 23 | 0.670 | 0.00002 |
| 25 | 0.730 | −0.00052 |
| 26 | 0.757 | 0.00033 |

- **Measurement noise:** index 25 read below zero, which puts the noise at about 0.0005%. That is larger than every positive reading, so the ranking is not statistically meaningful.
- **Why there's no signal:** the stable phases absorb only at higher photon energies than the 2.1 eV light. The band-gap model gives MgSb2O6 about 2.8 eV and Mg4Sb2O9 about 4.2 eV. Mg3Sb2O7 is predicted to absorb at low energy (0.24 eV), but the stability model puts it well off the stable set (0.137 eV/atom), so it probably doesn't form.
- **XRD (4 of 5 used):** at Sb 0.17, 0.41 and 0.56 only the platinum substrate peaks appear, so those films are amorphous or very thin. Index 26 is the only sample with extra peaks, meaning crystalline Sb-rich material forms there. That, plus its highest reading, is why I chose it.

**Coverage gaps:** I measured EQE at only 5 of the 27 compositions and skipped the whole 0.30–0.64 range. Given the noise, one more measurement there would not have changed the conclusion. The GP suggestion tool didn't help here because every predicted value was zero.
